question: How many states does the World Bank aided ‘STARS’ project under the New Education Policy initially propose to cover?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

__
 
• **Six states were proposed under **____**World Bank aided ‘STARS’ project under the New Education Policy**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **STARS** project aims at improving overall monitoring and measurement activities in the Indian school education system through interventions in selected states.

 
 
• ​Strengthening Teaching Learning and Results for the States will play a vital role in implementing the New Educational Policy 2020 which seeks to strengthen foundation learning, early childhood education, improvement of learning assessment, development of teachers, vocational education.
 
• An agreement has been signed by the Ministry of Education, Department of Economic Affairs, World Bank for financial assistance of Rs.5718 crores.
 
• The six states include Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Kerala, Odisha.
 
• The National Education Policy 2020 outlines the vision of the new education system in India.
